item.title: Stratigraphic correlation: Old concepts inform new approaches
item.description: In this talk, I first want to revisit and visualize the basic ideas about how time is recorded - or not recorded - in sedimentary deposits and then show how chronostratigraphic diagrams can be used as key elements of an automated workflow for correlating geophysical well logs.

item.title: Chronostratigraphic diagrams revisited: Visualization and correlation in the time domain
item.description: We use experimental data from the ‘Jurassic Tank‘ flume (St. Anthony Falls Laboratory) to create three-dimensional chronostratigraphic diagrams, compute stratigraphic completeness, and test several sequence stratigraphic concepts.
